description:
If someone is triggered by your growth, your clarity, or your standards, that’s not feedback. That’s projection.

You weren’t put here to be palatable.
You were put here to be honest.

The moment you stop editing yourself to keep other people comfortable is the moment your life gets lighter, your decisions get clearer, and your confidence gets stronger.

Be yourself. The right people will recognize you.
transcript: Dr. Seuss, he said, be who you are and say what you feel because those who mind don't matter and those who matter don't mind. Be yourself. Don't let anybody rob you of your true nature. You were made to be exactly who you are and you're perfect just the way you are.
spoken_hook_0_3s: He said, be who you are and say what you feel.
